name: API Test Performance
description: Response times, transaction phases and failures of synthetic API checks, with an overall summary and one section per protocol (HTTP, SSL, TCP, WebSocket, DNS, UDP, ICMP, gRPC, MCP, Network path). Only scheduled runs are recorded here: CI runs are not written to these stores. The check type picker narrows the overall section; each protocol section is fixed to its own type, and the monitor and location pickers narrow everything.

panels.name: Runs
panels.description: Check runs in the selected time range.

panels.name: Success rate
panels.description: Successful runs over all runs in the selected time range.

queries.label: A
queries.promql: sum (increase(kubesense_synthetics_runs_total{status="success", label_env=~"$env", label_team=~"$team", label_service=~"$service", monitor_name=~"$monitor", location=~"$location", check_type=~"$check_type"}[$__time_filter])) / sum (increase(kubesense_synthetics_runs_total{label_env=~"$env", label_team=~"$team", label_service=~"$service", monitor_name=~"$monitor", location=~"$location", check_type=~"$check_type"}[$__time_filter])) * 100

panels.name: Failed runs
panels.description: Failed runs in the selected time range.

panels.name: Failure trend
panels.description: Failed runs by why they failed (failure code).

queries.label: A
queries.promql: sum by (failure_code) (increase(kubesense_synthetics_runs_total{status="failure", label_env=~"$env", label_team=~"$team", label_service=~"$service", monitor_name=~"$monitor", location=~"$location", check_type=~"$check_type"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.name: Runs by check type
panels.description: Check runs per interval, by protocol.

variables.name: check_type
variables.description: Check type: HTTP, TCP, DNS, ... Applies to the overall section; each protocol section is fixed to its own type.

variables.name: location
variables.description: Location id (the agent id for an agent with no location; local = synthetics-api itself).

panels.name: Average response time (HTTP)
panels.description: Mean total run time of the selected time range.

panels.name: Transaction phase timings
panels.description: Mean dns, connect, tls, ttfb time per phase; a phase counts only when the check reports it.

queries.label: A
queries.promql: sum by (phase) (rate(kubesense_synthetics_phase_duration_seconds_sum{phase=~"dns|connect|tls|ttfb", label_env=~"$env", label_team=~"$team", label_service=~"$service", monitor_name=~"$monitor", location=~"$location", check_type="HTTP"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (phase) (rate(kubesense_synthetics_phase_duration_seconds_count{phase=~"dns|connect|tls|ttfb", label_env=~"$env", label_team=~"$team", label_service=~"$service", monitor_name=~"$monitor", location=~"$location", check_type="HTTP"}[$__rate_interval]))
